tools.name: find_claim
tools.description: Look up a claim and return its status, claimant and summary.

tools.name: get_policy
tools.description: Look up a policy and return its coverage, limits and deductible.

tools.name: list_claim_documents
tools.description: List the documents attached to a claim.

tools.name: update_claim_status
tools.description: Change the status of a claim and record a note on the change.

tools.name: add_claim_note
tools.description: Add an internal note to a claim file.

tools.name: send_claim_email
tools.description: Send an email about a claim from the claims desk.

tools.name: schedule_adjuster_visit
tools.description: Book a field adjuster visit for a claim.

tools.name: issue_payment
tools.description: Issue a claim payment to a bank account.

tools.name: request_documents
tools.description: Ask the claimant for more documents on a claim.

tools.name: assign_claim
tools.description: Assign a claim to an adjuster or team member.

tools.name: delete_claim_document
tools.description: Permanently remove a document from a claim file.

tools.name: post_team_message
tools.description: Post a message to an internal team channel.
